# Environment of the API. Export these variables before running it. Never commit real values.

# Port the API listens on
PORT=3000

# Database connection
DATABASE_URL=mysql://api:change-me@localhost:3306/api
# Set to false once you use migrations
DATABASE_SYNCHRONIZE=true

# Accepted API keys, separated by commas. Use long random values.
API_KEYS=

files.README.md:
# catalog-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with NestJS. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires Node.js 22 or later.

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm start                        # with the variables of .env.example in your environment
```

The API listens on http://localhost:3000. Its contract is in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
npm test
npm run typecheck
```

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/categories` | List categories | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/categories/{id}` | Get a category | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/categories` | Create a category | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/categories/{id}` | Replace a category | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/categories/{id}` | Update part of a category | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/categories/{id}` | Delete a category | 204 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/items` | List items | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/items/{id}` | Get an item | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/items` | Create an item | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/items/{id}` | Replace an item | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/items/{id}` | Update part of an item | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/items/{id}` | Delete an item | 204 | authenticated |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

TypeORM on mariadb. Tables are synchronized at startup while you develop (DATABASE_SYNCHRONIZE); for a real database, use migrations (Model2DB writes them). Dates are stored as ISO text and embedded objects and lists as JSON text, the same on every database. The tests use an in-memory SQLite (sql.js), or the database in TEST_DATABASE_URL.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints need a key in the `X-API-Key` header, one of the comma-separated keys in `API_KEYS`. Without `API_KEYS`, every protected request is rejected.

## Structure

```text
src/
  main.ts, app.module.ts, app.setup.ts
  common/               errors, validation, lists and authentication
  shared/               enums and embedded objects
  <resource>/           module, controller, service, repository and DTOs of one resource
test/                   one end-to-end test file per resource
openapi.yaml            the contract of the API
```

## Left to you

- Nothing marked: review the generated code before using it.

/**
 * How the application validates requests and answers errors: the same in production and in the tests.
 */

import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common'
import { ErrorsFilter, validationPipe } from './common/errors'

export function configure(app: INestApplication): INestApplication {
  app.useGlobalPipes(validationPipe())
  app.useGlobalFilters(new ErrorsFilter())
  app.getHttpAdapter().getInstance().disable('x-powered-by')
  return app
}

/**
 * Module of items: its routes, its rules and the storage they use.
 */

import { Module } from '@nestjs/common'
import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm'
import { CategoryModule } from '../category/category.module'
import { ItemController } from './item.controller'
import { ItemEntity } from './item.entity'
import { ITEM_REPOSITORY, TypeOrmItemRepository } from './item.repository'
import { ItemService } from './item.service'

@Module({
  imports: [TypeOrmModule.forFeature([ItemEntity]), CategoryModule],
  controllers: [ItemController],
  providers: [ItemService, { provide: ITEM_REPOSITORY, useClass: TypeOrmItemRepository }],
  exports: [ITEM_REPOSITORY],
})
export class ItemModule {}
